transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?
I… I’m here because I got scared. Sometimes after I eat too much, I make myself throw up so I don’t gain weight. It’s… been happening more than just once.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?
Most weeks, I guess. For the past few months at least… I’ll have one of those eating spells, usually in secret, and then I go make myself sick after. It’s not just once in a while anymore.
Do you often limit the amount or type of food you eat to avoid gaining weight?
I don’t know… not in any strict way, I guess. I try to watch what I eat sometimes, but I’m not sure I’d call it limiting.
Have you had any significant changes in your weight over the past few months?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed anything major… my clothes seem about the same, I think.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterwards?

Yes… sometimes. Like after bridge night, or if I get home late from work, I’ll just… eat what’s there. Leftover casserole, cookies, crackers, ice cream. More than I’d ever serve myself in front of someone.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Yes… I suppose I am. If my skirt feels tight, or I catch myself from the side in a mirror at the store, it can just… spoil the whole day. I feel like everyone can see I’ve let myself go.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterwards?

It’s not constant… but it happens sometimes after bridge night or when I get home late from work. I’ll eat leftovers, cookies, crackers, ice cream… all in one sitting. More than I’d ever put on a plate if someone were watching.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
Most weeks, I’d say. For the past several months, anyway. It’s… one of those times when I eat in secret, and then afterward I make myself sick. I don’t think I can really call it occasional anymore.
Do you always make yourself throw up after eating a large amount of food in a short period of time?

Not always… but too often. When I feel I’ve eaten too much, I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. That’s… what scared me into coming here. It’s not just a one-time thing anymore.
How many times a week do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time?
Most weeks… maybe not every week, but for several months now it’s been happening enough that I can’t really call it rare. Usually one of those secret eating spells, and then I get sick afterward.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterwards?
I’m not really sure. I don’t think that happens much without… doing that afterward. I haven’t kept track.
Do you ever make yourself throw up after eating a normal amount of food?

Sometimes, yes… if I feel like it was too much, even if maybe it wasn’t. I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I’m scared of gaining weight. It’s not something I can just brush off anymore.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating a normal amount of food?
I… I don’t know exactly. It’s gotten to where it’s not just a one-time thing anymore. If I feel like I ate too much, I’ll go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so I don’t gain weight.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterwards?
Sometimes after bridge night or a late shift… I’ll come home and eat a lot at once. Like leftovers, cookies, crackers, ice cream. More than I’d ever serve myself if someone was watching.
Do you usually make yourself throw up because you feel you've eaten too much during one of your secret eating spells, or because you're afraid of gaining weight in general?

Mostly after I feel like I’ve eaten too much… those times when I’m alone. I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up because I’m scared I’ll gain weight. It’s… happened more than once now. That’s what scared me.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating a meal that you would consider normal?

After a normal meal… not usually. It’s more when I feel like I’ve eaten too much. That’s when I go to the bathroom and make myself throw up so I don’t gain weight. It’s happened enough now that it scared me.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating a normal meal?
Not really after a normal meal. It’s when I think I’ve eaten too much… that’s when I go make myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. It’s happened more than once, and that’s what scared me.
How often do you eat a large amount of food in a short period of time without making yourself throw up afterwards?

Sometimes… if I’m very tired after bridge night or a late shift, I’ll come home and eat a lot all at once. Like leftovers, some cookies, crackers, maybe ice cream. More than I’d ever serve myself in front of anybody. I don’t always throw up after.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating a meal that you would consider normal?

Not after what I’d call a normal meal, no… it’s more when I feel I’ve eaten too much. Then I’ve gone and made myself throw up in the bathroom so I won’t gain weight. It’s happened enough that it doesn’t feel like just one mistake anymore.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating a meal that you would consider normal?
I… I don’t usually do it after a normal meal. It’s more when I feel like I’ve eaten too much. Then I’ve made myself throw up so I won’t gain weight. It’s happened enough that it scared me.
